title: Assessment of Climate Risk in Monetary Authority of Singapore’s Annual Industry-Wide Stress Test
what_it_is: Assessment of Climate Risk in Monetary Authority of Singapore’s Annual Industry-Wide Stress Test

sections.label: Environmental risk management consultation
sections.summary: MAS will issue a consultation paper on Environmental Risk Management guidelines and has started climate change stress tests, including a 2018 insurers' flooding scenario.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Locally, we will be issuing a consultation paper on Environmental Risk Management guidelines for various financial institutions in the first quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS has already started to stress test for climate change-related risks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For example, in the 2018 Industry-Wide Stress Test, MAS subjected insurers to a scenario featuring extreme flooding and they had to consider the impact of higher claims on their balance sheets arising from damage to insured properties.

sections.label: Broader climate risks in stress tests
sections.summary: MAS is working to include a broader range of climate change-related risks in thematic scenarios for a future Industry-Wide Stress Test.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS is working towards incorporating a broader range of climate change-related risks in thematic scenarios as part of a future Industry-Wide Stress Test.

sections.label: Current rule status
sections.summary: The passage states that today that is not the rule, as far as the speaker knows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Today, that is not the rule, as far as I know.

sections.label: Data needed for stress tests
sections.summary: The speaker says stress tests and financial evaluations will happen, but priority is collecting climate-related data as taxonomy is not worked out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It will happen in terms of stress tests, it will happen in terms of their financial evaluation of certain deals, of certain investments; and all these are happening and it will be within their own interest to disclose those data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I do not see why not, but for the time being, the priority is actually a much more basic one, which is there is not even the data to conduct a proper stress test.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: You really need to collect the data, the climate-related data, how does it impact the financial institutions and then you can do the stress test.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As we do that, that is why I said it is at the nascent stage, the taxonomy has not been worked out.
